expected_sql: SELECT d.name AS department, AVG(s.base_salary) AS avg_salary FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id JOIN salaries s ON e.emp_id = s.emp_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY avg_salary DESC
SELECT SUM(budget) FROM departments
SELECT d.name AS department, COUNT(e.emp_id) AS employee_count FROM departments d LEFT JOIN employees e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id GROUP BY d.name

query: Show total salary cost including bonuses by department
expected_sql: SELECT d.name AS department, SUM(s.base_salary + s.bonus) AS total_salary_cost FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id JOIN salaries s ON e.emp_id = s.emp_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY total_salary_cost DESC

SELECT d.name AS department, AVG((s.bonus / s.base_salary) * 100) AS avg_bonus_percentage FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id JOIN salaries s ON e.emp_id = s.emp_id GROUP BY d.name
SELECT name, roi_percent FROM campaigns ORDER BY roi_percent DESC LIMIT 100

query: Average sentiment score by customer industry
expected_sql: SELECT c.industry, AVG(i.sentiment_score) AS avg_sentiment_score FROM customers c JOIN interactions i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id GROUP BY c.industry ORDER BY avg_sentiment_score DESC
SELECT industry, SUM(total_ltv) AS total_ltv FROM customers GROUP BY industry ORDER BY total_ltv DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT c.name AS campaign_name, COUNT(cu.customer_id) AS total_customers FROM campaigns c LEFT JOIN customers cu ON c.campaign_id = cu.campaign_source_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_customers DESC
SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS interaction_count FROM interactions GROUP BY type ORDER BY interaction_count DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT w.location AS warehouse_location, SUM(i.quantity_on_hand) AS total_inventory FROM inventory i JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.location ORDER BY total_inventory DESC
SELECT name, MAX(rating) as rating FROM suppliers GROUP BY name ORDER BY rating DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count FROM shipments WHERE date(REPLACE(dispatch_date, '/', '-')) >= date((SELECT MAX(date(REPLACE(dispatch_date, '/', '-'))) FROM shipments) - 30 DAY) GROUP BY status ORDER BY shipment_count DESC
SELECT location, SUM(capacity) AS total_capacity FROM warehouses GROUP BY location ORDER BY total_capacity DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE i.quantity_on_hand < i.restock_threshold GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 100

query: Total revenue generated by sales rep
expected_sql: SELECT e.emp_id, e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS sales_rep, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON o.sales_rep_emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY e.emp_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_unpaid_amount FROM invoices WHERE status = 'unpaid' OR paid_date IS NULL

SELECT strftime("%Y-%m", REPLACE(o.date, '/', '-')) AS month, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders o WHERE REPLACE(o.date, '/', '-') >= date((SELECT MAX(strftime("%Y-%m", REPLACE(date, '/', '-'))) FROM orders), '-12 months') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
SELECT status, AVG(total_amount) AS avg_order_value FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC
SELECT strftime("%Y-%m", REPLACE(issue_date, '/', '-')) AS month, SUM(amount) AS total_invoice_amount FROM invoices GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT product_id, name, msrp FROM products ORDER BY msrp DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 100

query: Sales rep performance with department info
expected_sql: SELECT e.emp_id, e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS sales_rep, d.name AS department, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_sales FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id JOIN orders o ON e.emp_id = o.sales_rep_emp_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY e.emp_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 100

query: Customer LTV by acquisition campaign channel
expected_sql: SELECT c.channel, SUM(cu.total_ltv) AS total_ltv FROM customers cu JOIN campaigns c ON cu.campaign_source_id = c.campaign_id GROUP BY c.channel ORDER BY total_ltv DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT p.name AS product, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS total_revenue, SUM(p.unit_cost * oi.quantity) AS total_cost, SUM(oi.subtotal - p.unit_cost * oi.quantity) AS profit FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY profitability DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT w.warehouse_id, w.location, COUNT(s.shipment_id) AS shipment_count FROM shipments s JOIN warehouses w ON s.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.location ORDER BY shipment_count DESC LIMIT 100

WITH emp_sentiment AS (SELECT e.emp_id, e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS employee_name, AVG(i.sentiment_score) AS avg_sentiment FROM employees e JOIN interactions i ON e.emp_id = i.emp_id GROUP BY e.emp_id, e.first_name, e.last_name), sales_per_emp AS (SELECT e.emp_id, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_sales FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON e.emp_id = o.sales_rep_emp_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY e.emp_id) SELECT es.employee_name, es.avg_sentiment, sp.total_sales FROM emp_sentiment es JOIN sales_per_emp sp ON es.emp_id = sp.emp_id ORDER BY sp.total_sales DESC LIMIT 100

query: Top 3 products by revenue with running total
expected_sql: WITH product_revenue AS (SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY p.name) SELECT name, revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total FROM product_revenue ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

WITH dept_counts AS (SELECT d.name, COUNT(e.emp_id) AS emp_count FROM departments d LEFT JOIN employees e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id GROUP BY d.name) SELECT name, emp_count FROM dept_counts WHERE emp_count > (SELECT AVG(emp_count) FROM dept_counts) ORDER BY emp_count DESC LIMIT 100
